articles.title_en: Nonrepresentativeness in Population Health Research: Evidence from a COVID-19 Antibody Study
articles.title_cn: 人群健康研究中的非代表性：来自一项COVID-19抗体研究的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyze representativeness in a COVID-19 serological study with randomized participation incentives. We find large participation gaps by race and income when incentives are lower. High incentives increase participation rates for all groups but increase them more among under-represented groups. High incentives restore representativeness on race and income and also on health variables likely to be correlated with seropositivity, such as the uninsured rate, hospitalization rates, and an aggregate COVID-19 risk index. (JEL C83, I11, I14, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一项具有随机参与激励的COVID-19血清学研究中的代表性。我们发现，当激励较低时，种族和收入方面的参与差距较大。高激励提高了所有群体的参与率，但在代表性不足的群体中提高得更多。高激励恢复了种族和收入方面的代表性，也恢复了可能与血清阳性相关的健康变量的代表性，如未保险率、住院率和综合COVID-19风险指数。（JEL C83, I11, I14, J15）

articles.title_en: Zooming to Class? Experimental Evidence on College Students’ Online Learning during COVID-19
articles.title_cn: Zoom上课？COVID-19期间大学生在线学习的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: One persistent question in higher education is the efficacy of online education. In the fall of 2020, we randomized 551 West Point students in a required introductory economics course across 12 instructors to either an online or in-person class as a response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Final grades for online students dropped by 0.215 standard deviations, a result apparent in both assignments and exams and largest for academically at-risk students. A postcourse survey finds that online students struggled to concentrate in class and felt less connected to their instructors and peers. Our results show detrimental effects for online learning. (JEL A22, I12, I23, I26)
articles.abstract_cn: 高等教育中一个长期存在的问题是在线教育的有效性。2020年秋季，我们将西点军校551名选修一门必修经济学入门课程的学生随机分配到12名教师下的在线或面授课堂，以应对COVID-19疫情。在线学生的期末成绩下降了0.215个标准差，这一结果在作业和考试中均显而易见，且对学业上有风险的学生影响最大。课程后调查发现，在线学生在课堂上难以集中注意力，并感到与教师和同伴的联系减少。我们的结果表明在线学习存在不利影响。（JEL A22, I12, I23, I26）

articles.title_en: The Labor Market Impacts of Reducing Felony Convictions
articles.title_cn: 减少重罪定罪对劳动力市场的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the labor market impacts of retroactively reducing felonies to misdemeanors in San Joaquin County, California, where criminal justice agencies implemented Proposition 47 reductions in a quasi-random order, without requiring input or action from affected individuals. Linking records of reductions to administrative tax data, we find employment benefits for individuals who (likely) requested their reduction, consistent with selection, but no benefits among the larger subset of individuals whose records were reduced proactively. A field experiment notifying a subset of individuals about their proactive reduction also shows null results, implying that lack of awareness is unlikely to explain our findings. (JEL C93, H76, J22, K14, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了加利福尼亚州圣华金县追溯性地将重罪减少为轻罪对劳动力市场的影响，该县的刑事司法机构以准随机顺序实施了提案 47 减少罪名，而不需要受影响个人的意见或行动。将减少记录与行政税收数据联系起来，我们发现（可能）要求减少的个人有就业福利，这与选择一致，但主动减少记录的较大子集的个人没有受益。一项向一部分人通报其主动减少排放的现场实验也显示出无效结果，这意味着缺乏意识不太可能解释我们的发现。 （JEL C93、H76、J22、K14、K42）

articles.abstract_en: Transformative technologies like generative AI promise to accelerate productivity growth across many sectors, but they also present new risks from potential misuse. We develop a multisector technology adoption model to study the optimal regulation of transformative technologies when society can learn about these risks over time. Socially optimal adoption is gradual and typically convex. If social damages are large and proportional to the new technology’s productivity, a higher growth rate paradoxically leads to slower optimal adoption. Equilibrium adoption is inefficient when firms do not internalize all social damages, and sector-independent regulation is helpful but generally not sufficient to restore optimality. (JEL D21, H21, H25, O31, O33)
articles.abstract_cn: 生成式人工智能等变革性技术有望加速许多行业的生产率增长，但也带来了因潜在滥用而产生的新风险。我们构建了一个多部门技术采用模型，研究当社会可以随时间了解这些风险时，对变革性技术的最优监管。社会最优采用是渐进的，且通常是凸性的。如果社会损害较大且与新技术的生产率成比例，那么更高的增长率反而会导致更慢的最优采用。当企业不内化所有社会损害时，均衡采用是无效率的，而部门无关的监管是有帮助的，但通常不足以恢复最优性。（JEL D21, H21, H25, O31, O33）

articles.title_en: Central Bank Credibility and Fiscal Responsibility
articles.title_cn: 中央银行可信度与财政责任
articles.abstract_en: We consider a New Keynesian model with strategic monetary and fiscal interactions. The fiscal authority maximizes social welfare. Monetary policy is delegated to a central bank with an anti-inflation bias that suffers from a lack of commitment. The impact of central bank hawkishness on debt issuance is nonmonotonic because increased hawkishness reduces the benefit from fiscal stimulus while simultaneously increasing real debt capacity. Starting from high levels of hawkishness (dovishness), a marginal increase in the central bank’s anti-inflation bias decreases (increases) debt issuance. (JEL E12, E31, E52, E58, E62, H63)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个具有战略货币和财政互动的新凯恩斯主义模型。财政当局最大化社会福利。货币政策被委托给一个具有反通胀倾向但缺乏承诺能力的中央银行。中央银行鹰派立场对债务发行的非单调影响，是因为更强的鹰派立场降低了财政刺激的收益，同时增加了实际债务能力。从高水平的鹰派（鸽派）立场出发，中央银行反通胀倾向的边际增加会减少（增加）债务发行。（JEL E12, E31, E52, E58, E62, H63）

articles.title_en: The Socioeconomic Distribution of Choice Quality: Evidence from Health Insurance in the Netherlands
articles.title_cn: 选择质量的社会经济分布：来自荷兰健康保险的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how choice quality relates to socioeconomic factors, using population-wide data on health insurance choices and utilization in the Netherlands. We document a striking choice quality gradient with respect to socioeconomic status, finding that those with higher income, higher education, and training in quantitative fields make meaningfully better choices. Household income for the top 5 percent of decision-makers, in terms of surplus captured, is almost three times higher than for the bottom 5 percent. When jointly including all factors, education degree and field of study are more important predictors of choice quality than income and other financial variables. (JEL D31, G22, G52, I13, L15)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用荷兰健康保险选择和利用的全人口数据，研究选择质量如何与社会经济因素相关。我们记录了选择质量与社会经济地位之间显著的梯度关系，发现收入较高、教育程度较高以及接受过定量领域培训的人做出的选择明显更好。就获得的剩余而言，排名前5%的决策者的家庭收入几乎是排名后5%的决策者的三倍。当将所有因素共同纳入时，教育程度和学习领域比收入和其他财务变量更能预测选择质量。（JEL D31, G22, G52, I13, L15）

articles.abstract_en: We formalize Tilly’s concept of repertoires of collective action and analyze how state repression affects the variety of observed contentious actions. When repression accelerates with higher levels of antiregime actions (convex repression structure), opposition leaders tend to call for many different forms of contentious actions, thereby generating a wider repertoire. In contrast, when repression decelerates with higher contentious actions (concave repression structure, including indiscriminate repression), opposition leaders tend to call for just one form of contentious action, thereby generating a narrower repertoire. Methodologically, we deliver an analysis for settings in which coordination and delegation are intertwined. (JEL D71, D72, D74, D82)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们形式化了蒂利关于集体行动剧目的概念，并分析国家镇压如何影响所观察到的抗争行动的多样性。当镇压随着反政权行动水平的升高而加速（凸性镇压结构）时，反对派领导人倾向于号召多种不同形式的抗争行动，从而产生更广泛的剧目。相反，当镇压随着抗争行动的升高而减速（凹性镇压结构，包括不分青红皂白的镇压）时，反对派领导人倾向于只号召一种形式的抗争行动，从而产生更狭窄的剧目。在方法论上，我们提供了对协调与委托相互交织情境的分析。（JEL D71, D72, D74, D82）

articles.title_en: Dynamic Spending Responses to Wealth Shocks: Evidence from Quasi Lotteries on the Stock Market
articles.title_cn: 财富冲击的动态支出反应：来自股市准彩票的证据
articles.abstract_en: How much and over what horizon do households adjust their consumption in response to stock market wealth shocks? We address these questions using granular data on spending and stock portfolios from a large bank and exploiting lottery-like variation in gains across investors with similar portfolio characteristics. Consistent with the permanent income hypothesis, spending responses to stock market gains are immediate and persistent. The monthly responses cumulate to marginal propensities to consume of 4.4 percent over one year and 16 percent over three years. The results suggest that inattention attenuates household responses to stock market cycles over horizons as long as one year. (JEL D12, E21, G11, G14, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 家庭如何以及在多长时间范围内调整其消费以应对股市财富冲击？我们利用一家大型银行的支出和股票投资组合的细粒度数据，并利用具有相似投资组合特征的投资者之间收益的彩票式变化来解决这些问题。与永久收入假说一致，对股市收益的支出反应是即时且持久的。月度反应累积为一年内边际消费倾向4.4%，三年内16%。结果表明，在长达一年的时间范围内，忽视会减弱家庭对股市周期的反应。（JEL D12, E21, G11, G14, G51）
